mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, which may increase infection risk in patients taking nifedipine; additionally, hyperthyroidism treated with PTU affects cardiovascular hemodynamics that nifedipine is managing.
action: Monitor for signs of infection and agranulocytosis (fever, sore throat, unusual bruising); ensure thyroid function is adequately controlled as untreated hyperthyroidism may reduce nifedipine efficacy.
